questions.question: Describe the basics of Ayurveda. / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:
• Describe the basics of Ayurveda. [U] / [CO1]
  • Ayurveda is one of the world’s oldest holistic healing systems, developed in India over 3,000
  • years ago. The term comes from Sanskrit—“Ayur” (life) and “Veda” (knowledge)—meaning
  • “the science of life.” It focuses on maintaining health through balance in body, mind, and spirit.

questions.question: Why is risk sharing important in PPP? / [CO4]
questions.solution_html:
• Why is risk sharing important in PPP? [An] / [CO4]
  • Risk sharing is a core principle of Public–Private Partnerships (PPP) because it determines
  • whether a project is efficient, financially viable, and sustainable. In a PPP, risks are allocated
  • between the public sector and private sector in a way that each party handles the risks it is best
  • equipped to manage.

questions.question: Explain the role of classical dance in promoting cultural tourism. / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:
• Explain the role of classical dance in promoting cultural tourism. [U] / [CO1]
  • Classical dance plays a powerful role in promoting cultural tourism by showcasing a
  • destination’s heritage, traditions, and artistic identity. In India, classical dances are not just
  • performances—they are living expressions of history, religion, and regional culture that attract
  • tourists from around the world.

questions.question: Evaluate the role of monuments in promoting heritage tourism. / [CO2]
questions.solution_html:
• Evaluate the role of monuments in promoting heritage tourism. [An] / [CO2]
  • Monuments are central to heritage tourism because they embody a region’s history, architecture,
  • and cultural identity. Their role goes beyond sightseeing—they function as cultural symbols,
  • educational resources, and economic drivers.
